b01.heading: Longfu88 on Android and iOS: Safe Mobile Casino Access
b01.text: Longfu88 is used on a smartphone or tablet through a responsive website, on Android and iOS, and this page is written for players from Singapore aged 18 or over. The Longfu88 mobile casino is that website, opened in the phone browser. Players who look for the Longfu app will find the mobile version of the site with a home-screen shortcut, not a store app. Account protection, technical data, the shortcut, identity checks, responsible gaming and support follow below.

b02.heading: How the Account Stays Protected on a Phone
b02.text: The account holder is responsible for safeguarding the login credentials, that is the details which open the account, and this duty is the same on a phone or tablet as on a computer. One habit follows directly from it: a device that stays unlocked should not be handed to anyone else, even briefly. The operator has a separate part. Technical and organisational safeguards protect accounts, payments and personal information on Longfu88, and the casino may suspend activity for verification or suspected abuse. Both parts concern the account itself, so they apply whichever device opens it.

b03.heading: Which Technical Data the Website Collects
b03.text: The mobile website collects technical data from the phone: the IP address, device data, browser information and cookies. Four kinds of cookies are in use, necessary, preference, analytics and marketing, and they support website functions and measurement. This data may be shared with payment service providers, identity verification providers and technology providers, and with regulators and law enforcement when required.

b04.heading: Signing In Safely from a Phone
b04.text: Registration is by e-mail only, and the account is reached from a phone exactly as from a computer. On Longfu88 the player selects Login on the website, enters the registered e-mail and password, and completes any security check to access the account. A player who has forgotten the password uses Forgot Password on the login screen, and the separate login page of the site covers that route in detail.

b05.heading: Longfu88 Download: A Shortcut Instead of a File
b05.text: Longfu88 works in the browser of a smartphone or tablet, so the player adds a shortcut of the casino website to the home screen once and opens it from there afterwards. Nobody needs an installation file or a Longfu88 apk, because the casino opens in the mobile browser and sits on the home screen as a shortcut, with no file and no store listing involved. The next two sub-sections give the steps for Android in Chrome and for iOS in Safari.

b06.heading: Longfu88 Android: Chrome Shortcut
b06.text:
Chrome on an Android phone adds a shortcut of the casino website to the home screen, and it takes three steps in this order:

1. Open the casino website in Chrome.
2. Open the browser menu and choose Add to Home screen.
3. Confirm the shortcut.

The shortcut then appears among the apps of the phone.

b07.heading: Longfu88 iOS: Safari Shortcut
b07.text:
On an iPhone or iPad the route runs through Safari, and the Share option is its central step:

1. Open the casino website in Safari.
2. Tap Share and choose Add to Home Screen.
3. Confirm Add.

Safari then places a shortcut of the casino website on the home screen of the iPhone or iPad.

b08.heading: Shortcut Versus Browser Tab
b08.text: Both ways open the same responsive website, so the account, deposits, withdrawals and bonuses are identical whether the casino starts from an icon or from a tab. The shortcut is set up once and then gives a one-tap icon on the home screen. A browser tab needs no setup at all. A phone that opens Longfu88 often suits the shortcut, whereas a device used rarely is better served by a tab.

b09.heading: Identity Checks and Account Verification
b09.text:
Account verification may be requested during an account review, before a withdrawal, after unusual or high-value transactions and after changes to account or payment details. The identity documents involved are these:

- Government-issued photo ID or passport
- Proof of residential address
- Proof of ownership of a payment method
- Source of funds or wealth documents when requested

Documents are submitted within up to 30 days when requested, and a complete set is typically reviewed within up to 10 days.

b10.heading: Responsible Play on a Phone
b10.text: Responsible gaming starts with an age rule: players must be at least 18 years old and gamble only where lawful. Self-assessment questions help players identify possible gambling-related harm, so they work as a check for anyone who plays on a phone regularly. Independent support organisations are named for players who prefer to talk to someone outside the casino: GamCare, Gamblers Anonymous and Gambling Therapy.

b11.heading: Devices and Browsers
b11.text: The supported platforms are Android, iOS and the mobile web, which covers phones and tablets alike. Longfu88 uses one responsive layout that adapts to smartphone and tablet screens. Chrome is the browser of the Android shortcut route and Safari that of the iOS route, and none of these platforms needs an installation file.

b12.heading: Reaching Support
b12.text: Customer support answers mobile and account questions through live chat, available 24/7, and through e-mail at support@longfu88.com. A shortcut that does not appear, a page that does not load, a login problem or a request about documents all belong here. The team works in English, Malay, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Indonesian and Vietnamese.

b13.heading: Longfu88 App Safety FAQ
b13.text:
- **Does Longfu88 have a store app?** No, the casino opens in the phone browser and is added to the home screen as a shortcut.
- **How does a player log in to Longfu88 on a phone?** With the registered e-mail and password, as on a computer.
- **What is the minimum age?** It is 18, and the player must be legally permitted to gamble where they live.
- **How is the iOS shortcut added?** Open the casino website in Safari, tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, confirm Add.
- **How is the Android shortcut added?** Open the casino website in Chrome, choose Add to Home screen, confirm.
- **Where to turn when something fails?** Customer support, by live chat 24/7 or e-mail.
